race.comment: SYLPH (10) has had a couple good hoops on her this prep down in NSW but just hasn't quite been able to land the winning blow when coming from tricky spots. If Graham can settle her close from the low draw and get the gap, she will prove mighty tough to stop. SPIETHTACULAR (9) is as reliable and more than deserves her crack at some black type. Expect her to burn across from out there and give another bold sight. Can steal it if left alone. BALANCE THE BOOKS (6) was well below her best here fresh when sent out fav but was poor to recover. Thompson sticks for the Gollan runner. That's enough for me. JUST PRECIOUS (2) was also a fair way off the mark last time but did have breathing issues post race. She's another worth forgiving. MERCY ME (12) is a handy mare resuming for the Doyle camp. Trialled well at Scone and is drawn to get a lovely run. Suspect she will make her presence felt.
